comments.author: Adrian Cosentino
comments.text:
Fresh review B findings for PR #111:

High: crates/blip-core/src/blob.rs:55-83 runs recover() at the start of every LocalBlobStore::write(), and recover() unconditionally removes every file in the shared tmp directory. With two writers using the same blob store, one writer can delete another writer's just-created temp file before hard_link publishes it, causing a spurious write failure and violating the atomic-from-caller write guarantee. Recovery should only clean stale/non-owned temp files, or run under store-level coordination, rather than clearing all tmp files on each write.

High: crates/blip-core/src/store.rs:423-429 has a TOCTOU data-loss race in metadata rollback cleanup. After a failed metadata insert, it checks whether the content-addressed blob_ref is referenced and then deletes it, but no DB/file lock protects the interval between the SELECT and delete. Another process can commit a payload row for the same deduped blob_ref after the check and before delete, leaving that row pointing at a missing blob. Immediate rollback cleanup needs coordination/proof of ownership, or should defer physical deletion to a coordinated GC pass.

Verification run: gh pr view 111 --json ...; gh pr diff 111 --color=never; gh issue view 65 --json title,body,state; cargo test -p blip-core blob -- --nocapture (passed, 13 tests); cargo check -p blip-core (passed). Also attempted a multi-filter cargo test invocation, but cargo accepts only one TESTNAME and rejected the command before running tests.

Recommendation: do not merge until these lifecycle races are fixed or explicitly scoped to a single-writer store with enforcement.

comments.author: Adrian Cosentino
comments.text: Addressed review B findings: recover now preserves recent temp files and only stale cleanup removes tmp files; insert_blob_payload no longer deletes blobs on metadata failure, leaving unreferenced blobs for GC to avoid check/delete races. Verification passed: cargo fmt --check, focused blip-core blob/store tests, cargo check --workspace, cargo test --workspace.

comments.author: Adrian Cosentino
comments.text: Findings: typed payload schema already has nullable blip_payloads.blob_ref plus content_hash/byte_size/metadata, FK cascade from blips, and store decoding via ClipboardPayload. Minimal schema addition recommended: index blip_payloads(blob_ref) WHERE blob_ref IS NOT NULL for referenced-ref enumeration/shared-ref checks; no separate blob table needed unless future blob inventory/audit requires it. Integration gaps: LocalBlobStore is not exported from blip-core lib.rs and currently relies on BlipError variants/io conversion not present in error.rs, so wiring it in must first add pub mod blob and blob errors. Store APIs needed: NewClipboardPayload input; insert_blip_with_payloads/write flow that writes blobs first then inserts blip + payload rows in one SQLite tx, with cleanup of newly written unreferenced blob refs on DB failure; referenced_blob_refs() -> HashSet<String>; delete_blip_and_collect_orphans/delete_payload_and_collect_orphans that snapshots blob refs, deletes SQLite rows, commits, then deletes only refs no longer present in blip_payloads. Avoid direct LocalBlobStore::delete during row deletion; prefer LocalBlobStore::garbage_collect(&store.referenced_blob_refs()?) for crash-safe cleanup. Tests needed: binary payload insert stores blob metadata; DB rollback removes newly unique blob but not preexisting dedup blob; delete one of two payloads sharing blob keeps file; delete last ref removes file; referenced_blob_refs returns distinct non-null refs; FK cascade deletes payload metadata before orphan cleanup; GC keeps referenced and removes orphan files.
